tokenization_note_from_step210.interpretation: Compact has slightly more BPE active/candidate tokens for the same legal word count; the difference is part of the natural compact-vs-repeat treatment and is concentrated in compact-pair rows in the 10M audit.

primary: best late compact-minus-repeat with family decomposition
scientific_readout_after_launch.continue_if: Compact is positive on late stable metrics and not carried solely by GlobalPIQA/Reading.
scientific_readout_after_launch.localize_if: Compact is neutral/negative on late stable metrics despite full exposure; this localizes the compact data effect to the DeBERTa coordinate or to interactions absent in this RoBERTa run.

cost_admission.why_expensive_work_would_be_admitted: Two full 100M RoBERTa runs resolve an independent architecture-transfer question for the validated compact-vs-repeat data marginal; 20M/40M cannot close it because the original effect emerged late.
cost_admission.minimum_reliable_method: CPU/file preflight plus matched full 100M pair audit before launch; then full 100M training on both H100s with 10M checkpoints and selected official-compatible scoring on the late band.
cost_admission.would_continue_route_if: compact beats repeat on late stable metrics, not just GlobalPIQA/Reading
cost_admission.would_change_route_if: compact is neutral/negative on late stable metrics after full exposure, localizing the effect to DeBERTa/relative-position coordinate or requiring a different mechanism decomposition
